summary: Frontend-only Playwright test of the tour videos (TourVideo.jsx) for the doctor (medico@mantmed.it) and the parent (genitore.demo@example.com). Desktop 1920x800: all 5 steps for each role show tour-video-preview, and currentSrc is /tour/{role}-N.webm (headless Chromium has no H.264). The preview autoplays muted and looped, and currentTime goes up. tour-video-expand opens tour-video-fullscreen, and tour-video-full plays. tour-video-close, Escape and a backdrop click close only the fullscreen; the tour stays on the same step. The parent passed 5/5. The doctor passed 5/5 in 2 of 3 runs. In the first run, step 5 (doctor-5) stayed stuck on currentSrc=doctor-5.mp4 with readyState 0 and paused after 2.8s (intermittent, see RCA). saveData: at 1280px, overriding Navigator.prototype.connection={saveData:true} gives tour-video-play, preload=none, no autoplay and only the jpg requested. A click on play starts the webm, and the next step shows the play button again. Mobile 390x844: the preview is hidden, and tour-video-thumb shows the poster jpg (it loads). Tapping it opens the fullscreen video, which plays, and close works. BUT the hidden preview video still downloads the full clip on every step before any tap (see the critical bug). Static files: /tour/doctor-1.mp4, .webm and .jpg return 200 with video/mp4, video/webm and image/jpeg. Layout: the card fits at 1920x800 (card about 80-776px, Avanti/Indietro bottom at about 751px) and at 768x1024 (card about 243-1000px, buttons bottom at 975px), so nothing overflows. Clip content was checked with 6-frame contact sheets: doctor-2 shows the consultation prep and then 'Registrazione in corso' with a timer and waveform (OK). doctor-3 goes visits list > visit > Bodychart with a figure and pins (OK, but with a blank spinner frame at about 4.5-5.5s). doctor-4 shows the team network CF search, 'Cartella condivisa non accessibile' and 'Richiesta di autorizzazione' (OK, but it was recorded as the cardiologist). doctor-5 shows Vetrina and then Fatturazione & TS (OK). patient-4 shows the Trova Specialista search > showcase > slots (OK). patient-5 shows the 'Dubbio clinico' message composer being typed (OK). Both demo accounts were left with tour_done=true (/api/auth/me checked).

ui_bugs.issue: Preview is hidden only by CSS ('hidden sm:block'), but its <video autoPlay preload='auto'> is still mounted. On 390x844 every step downloads {id}.mp4 and {id}.webm (readyState=4, fully buffered) before any tap, so 10 clips (~1-2 MB) load over mobile data. This breaks the requirement that on phones the video starts and loads only when tapped.

Intermittent (1 of 3 runs): after step 4 (fullscreen opened and closed), step 5 video stuck with currentSrc=doctor-5.mp4, readyState=0, paused, and never fell back to webm within about 3s. Other runs were fine.

ArrowRight/ArrowLeft while tour-video-fullscreen is open still reach GuidedTour's window keydown handler. The tour moves to the next step (it navigated to /portale/documenti) and the fullscreen unmounts. Arrow keys also clash with seeking in the native video controls.

issues: doctor-1 (6.3s) and patient-1 (6.0s) are shorter than the agreed 8-12s, yet the mobile thumb says '10 secondi' (hardcoded) for every clip.

doctor-4 was recorded logged in as 'Dott. Marco Bianchi / cardiologo.demo@example.com' with 'Archivio di studio cardiologico - Nessun paziente trovato', while the doctor tour belongs to Dott.ssa Foti (pediatrics), so the identity is inconsistent.
doctor-3 has about 1s of blank Bodychart frame with a loading spinner (about 4.5-5.5s). The patient name shown is lowercase 'eleonora', while the clicked visit card reads 'Pietro Fontana'.
doctor-2 spends about 70% of the clip on patient selection; only the last 2-3s show the recording, and no transcription or note generation is shown.
The card plus video thumb now spans about 398-832px (more than half of the 844 viewport), so it covers even more of the spotlit target than in iteration_39.
tour-video-fullscreen has no role='dialog' or aria-modal, and focus is neither moved to the close button nor trapped.

action_items: HIGH: In TourVideo, do not mount the Preview <video> below the sm breakpoint. Use a matchMedia('(min-width:640px)') hook to render Preview or Thumb conditionally (not just CSS-hide), or at least set preload='none' and no autoPlay when small.

Put the webm <source> first, or give the mp4 source a codecs type (type='video/mp4; codecs="avc1.42E01E"'), so browsers without H.264 skip it straight away. Chromium returns canPlayType('video/mp4')='maybe', so it fetches the mp4 first on every step, and this is the likely cause of the intermittent doctor-5 stall.
Stop ArrowLeft/ArrowRight (and Escape, already done) in the Fullscreen capture keydown handler while it is open, or have GuidedTour ignore keys when the fullscreen is open.

Re-record doctor-1 and patient-1 to at least 8s, record doctor-4 as medico@mantmed.it (pediatric account), trim the blank Bodychart loading frame in doctor-3, show more of the recording or transcription in doctor-2, and compute the '10 secondi' label from the real duration or make it generic.
Add role='dialog', aria-modal and autofocus on tour-video-close to the fullscreen.
critical_code_review_comments: TourVideo.jsx Preview: the saveData() check covers tablets/desktop only. Phones depend on CSS 'hidden', which does not stop media downloads (see the HIGH bug).
The Sources order is mp4 then webm with a bare type, which wastes a request on every step in Chromium builds without H.264.
Fullscreen keydown capture only intercepts Escape, so the other tour shortcuts leak through.

success_rate.frontend: 86% (about 19/22 checks; failures: mobile pre-tap loading, intermittent doctor-5 load, arrow keys in fullscreen)

test_credentials: From /app/memory/test_credentials.md: medico@mantmed.it / Auscula-Studio-2026, genitore.demo@example.com / Portale-Demo-2026 (both worked)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Wait about 2.5s after login-form appears before filling. The doctor tour is opened with tour-open-button (desktop only) and the parent tour with portal-tour-open-btn. For the saveData test, add_init_script then page.reload(), because the tool navigates before the script runs; override Navigator.prototype.connection. To check whether mobile loads video before a tap, log page.on('request') for '/tour/' and read the hidden tour-video readyState. Headless Chromium plays webm; canPlayType('video/mp4') returns 'maybe'. Contact sheets: draw seeked frames on a canvas from /tour/{id}.webm. Both demo accounts are left with tour_done=true.
rca of the issue: Mobile pre-tap loading: GuidedTour renders <TourVideo>, which always mounts both Preview (hidden below sm via Tailwind 'hidden sm:block') and Thumb. display:none does not stop a <video preload='auto' autoPlay> from fetching and buffering, so readyState=4 is reached without any tap. Repro: 390x844, open the tour, watch for '/tour/patient-1.webm' requests before tapping the thumb. Fix: render Preview conditionally with matchMedia. Doctor-5 stall: mp4 is listed first and Chromium reports 'maybe', so it fetches the mp4, fails to decode and only then falls back to webm. In one run this fallback had not finished (readyState 0) about 3s after entering step 5, right after a fullscreen video for step 4 had been torn down. Fix: webm first, or a codecs-qualified mp4 type.
